_meta.note: Parity-oracle state matrix for CSP hardening (Task 0B). Each component lists the states whose CURRENT (pre-refactor) styling derives from a CSP-blocking construct (declarative style=, injected <style>, SVG style=, injected @keyframes/animation). 'markup' = HTML inserted into the mount root (custom-element components self-upgrade). 'setup' = JS run in the page to reach a static-class / portaled state. 'selectors' = the styled elements whose computed style is snapshotted (the elements that currently receive inline/injected styling). 'pseudo' = a hover/focus/open driver applied by the capture script before snapshot. 'portal' = element lives on document.body, not in the mount root. 'excludeProps' = props excluded for THIS state because they are time/layout/random-dependent (documented in MATRIX.md).
_meta.tokenNativeNote: Components migrated to token CSS (ADR 0008). Their baselines are captured with td.css ONLY (no Tailwind). csp.spec: the default run serves td.css only for them; the legacy+td run serves Tailwind + td.css and compares against the SAME baselines (host Tailwind must not alter them).
_meta.mixedNote: Legacy components that render token-native children (td-table → td-pagination, td-empty-state) are served Tailwind + td.css in BOTH runs; their baselines are captured the same way.
